title: CFPCPattern
description: Context Fluency Pattern Creation pattern contract v1.

intent.description: Human-readable description of what the pattern resolves.

phase.description: C6 phase where this pattern anchors its field resolution.

@captures.description: Map of capture variable name to capture spec.

oneOf.description: Simple wildcard: bind entire lowercased query.

strip_prefix.description: Strip this prefix from the lowercased query before binding.

from_captures.description: Which capture names to resolve neighborhoods for.

max_hops.description: Maximum graph traversal depth. Currently 1-hop only.

question_templates.description: Templates for candidate question generation. Supports {subject}, {neighbor}, {field_keys} placeholders.

context_template.description: Template for the Xul-phase context_text output. Supports same placeholders plus {query} and {neighbors}.
